reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her thread: the seat count for the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is 261.

That number comes only from Ilse's Oct 14 post in #north-team. Nothing posted in the channel since then changes it. I couldn't check it against a signed document: there's no Quarrendon contract or order form in the files she can see. A March note says the renewal was signed on 2026-03-20 but gives no seat count. So I suggested she confirm the signed number with Ilse or June before it goes in the tracker.
